title: IAM-A gets its own healthy range, from two laboratories
set_out: Goal for the day: take IAM-A through its last gates to commissioning: the second laboratory, its own healthy range, the clean room, then the grand sealed test.
open_at_turnover: Running: the IAM-A grand test (three machines on one queue); the IAM-A clean room.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out
sections.lead: Each rule was written down before its data was read, and every count runs through the chain.

entries.title: Healthy B cells from a second laboratory read close to IAM-A's line
entries.what: Three healthy donors from a second laboratory passed IAM-A's sample check and read close to its line, on the same side as the first laboratory's B cells. The differences among the three follow how completely each sample's chemistry converted; comparing the two laboratories on the same footing is the next step.

entries.title: IAM-A's own healthy range, sealed before the data
entries.what: IAM-A's healthy range now comes from healthy people measured in two laboratories (156 readings), by a rule sealed before the second laboratory's counts were read.

entries.title: IAM-Atlas v2.1 commissioned for its first uses
entries.what: The 79-cell atlas, fitted as one model from seven public sources, is commissioned for three cell references and for the sites our colon and lung cancer tests rely on, each on a bar fixed before the atlas existed. Its other uses stay in development.

entries.title: The IAM-A grand test is aligning its 13 healthy samples
entries.what: Three machines share one work list after AWS took back two spot machines; the sealed rule is unchanged.

entries.title: IAM-A clean room, from a fresh public copy
entries.what: A new machine clones the public repository and recounts the line's samples from GEO and ENCODE; every number must match what is committed.

sections.heading: Every lever test: what ran, what it showed, what is left
sections.lead: No lever test today; the work is IAM-A's commissioning.

sections.heading: Every candidate instrument: what ran today, what remains
sections.lead: The commissioned instruments are unchanged; IAM-A's gates are the work today.

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: Our atlas beats the field's reference on its own jobs
entries.what: On 731 healthy arrays from independent laboratories, v2.1 split blood mixtures 26 percent more accurately than Moss's published reference and, with brain cells Moss's reference cannot see, recovered them in 87 percent of mixtures.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes today, and what caught each

entries.title: The manifest fell behind the work
entries.what: Overnight the log and the machine list moved while the testing manifest did not. Now the chain writes its own results into the manifest, and the push gate refuses any change whose manifest row did not move.

entries.title: Fewer documents to keep current
entries.what: Nine hand-kept status documents became two (the development log and this day log); everything else is built from the manifest and the chain, so it cannot go stale.
